description: This PHP class defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing termination reasons in the OrangeHRM system, including methods for creating, retrieving, counting, and deleting termination reason records from the database.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationDao
classes.description: DAO class for handling database operations related to termination reasons, extending the base DAO class.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Persists a new or updated TerminationReason entity to the database.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingTerminationReasonIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing termination reasons from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason by name, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of termination reasons based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for paginated retrieval of termination reasons.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Returns the count of termination reasons matching filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes termination reasons identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason with the specified name exists.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of termination reasons currently in use by employees.
